mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.column_name, t.column_name_cn, t.is_not_null, t.column_type, t.column_length, s.id sid, t.is_primary_key, t.model_id, t.id as column_id, s.is_query, s.is_visible, s.sort_num, t.model_version, s.create_date, s.update_date, s.is_advanced_query_index, s.is_custom_query, s.advanced_query_order, s.is_advanced_query, s.sortable,s.is_jump_link, s.menu_id, s.menu_path, s.link_re_meta_model_id, s.link_re_meta_model, s.link_re_meta_model_cn, s.link_re_column_id, s.link_re_column_name, s.link_re_column_name_cn, s.is_merge_rows, s.relate_search_condition, s.relate_search_attribute_id, s.relate_search_attribute, s.relate_search_name, rule.customized_sql,s.icon,s.is_style,ss.id AS style_id,ss.value,ss.style, ( SELECT table_name FROM t_meta_model WHERE CONCAT( id ) = rule.rel_meta_mode_id ) rel_meta_mode_id, ( SELECT column_name FROM t_meta_model_tech WHERE CONCAT( id ) = rule.rel_id_meta_model_column_id ) rel_id_meta_model_column_id, ( SELECT column_name FROM t_meta_model_tech WHERE CONCAT( id ) = rule.rel_name_meta_model_column_id ) rel_name_meta_model_column_id FROM t_meta_model_tech t LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_show s ON (s.model_id = t.model_id AND s.model_version = t.model_version AND s.column_id = t.id) LEFT JOIN t_quality_verification_rules rule ON (rule.meta_model_column_id = CONCAT( t.id ) AND rule.rel_meta_mode_id IS NOT NULL AND rule.rel_meta_mode_id != '') LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_show_style ss ON s.model_id = s.model_id AND ss.model_version = ss.model_version AND s.column_id = ss.column_id
